compiled_state.description:
## testing_mode: GREEN

Add a mandatory Bug Classification step to the retro SKILL.md. Make test-retro-classification-step.sh pass.

## Read first
Read plugins/dso/skills/retro/SKILL.md — understand the current structure and find a suitable insertion point (likely after the main findings section, before session wrap-up).

## Content to add
A section named 'Bug Classification' (marked MANDATORY) that:
1. Calls bug-classification-stats.sh --window-days <bug_classification.retro_window_days (default 60)>
2. Fires EACH as a DISTINCT labeled finding when threshold triggers:
   (a) bug-type-uncategorized count >= recurrence_threshold (default 3): labeled finding
   (b) any registry slug count >= recurrence_threshold: labeled finding
   (c) ANY bug-type-classifier-failed-* tag present (threshold=1): labeled finding
3. When NO trigger fires: emit EXACTLY: 'Bug classification health: no threshold breaches in this window.'

## Done when
bash tests/scripts/test-retro-classification-step.sh exits 0 AND previous retro tests still pass.
